jobs.title: Fullstack utvecklare
jobs.description:
September 15, 2026

Full Time, Onsite, Sub consultant

Sverige

Posted 3 weeks ago

Vi söker en **Fullstack utvecklare** för ett uppdrag som utförs i **Sverige.**

**Uppdragsbeskrivning:**

Vi söker en engagerad och driven fullstack utvecklare som vill vara med och skapa innovativa webblösningar som gör skillnad. Hos oss får du arbeta i ett agilt DevSecOps-team där samarbete, lärande och respekt för olika perspektiv är en självklar del av vardagen. Vi värdesätter både din tekniska kompetens och din vilja att bidra till en inkluderande och hållbar digital framtid.

**Ansvarsområden**

* Utveckla och underhålla webbaserade applikationer med fokus på end-to-end-lösningar
* Samarbeta nära UX/UI-designers för att skapa användarvänliga och tillgängliga lösningar
* Arbeta enligt agila metoder och testdriven utveckling
* Bidra med problemlösning och nya idéer
* Stötta webbperspektivet i större verksamhetsprojekt
* Dokumentera tekniska lösningar och processer
* Säkerställa kodkvalitet genom enhetstester och automatiserade tester
* Arbeta med secure software development i enlighet med legala ramverk för IT- och informationssäkerhet

**Kravprofil**

**Skills:**

* Minst 4 – 5 års erfarenhet av webbutveckling

**Teknisk kompetens**

* C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, CSS
* Angular 18+
* Azure DevOps och molnlösningar
* Rest, JSON, XML
* CSS-ramverk som Tailwind eller Bootstrap
* CMS-erfarenhet, gärna EpiServer/Optimizely
* Oauth och Open Identity
* Visual Studio, Postman
* Testdriven utveckling och automatiserade tester

**Meriterande erfarenheter**

* Docker
* SQL och databaser
* Redis eller andra cachelösningar
* Webbanalysverktyg som Google Analytics eller Piwik PRO
* Språkkrav: Flytande svenska & engelska i tal och skrift

**Anställningsform**

Vi erbjuder två möjligheter:

* Fast anställning hos oss på RPS Software AB
* Samarbete som underkonsult (om du har eget bolag)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

Flatiron Health is a healthtech company using data for good to power smarter care for every person with cancer, around the world. Flatiron partners with cancer centers in the US, Europe and Asia to transform patients’ real-life experiences into real-world evidence and create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. Our multidisciplinary teams include oncologists, data scientists, software engineers, epidemiologists, product experts and more. Flatiron Health is an independent affiliate of the Roche Group.

What You'll Do

This role will design and develop technology in partnership with other software engineers in the US, UK, Germany, and Japan. Additionally, this role will collaborate day-to-day with oncologists, clinicians, product leaders, quantitative scientists, and customers to understand their challenges and how technology can help solve them.

Create new or enhance existing business critical, complex data pipelines using a variety of data processing tools and automation
Expand our capabilities in Deep Learning and LLM-powered extraction of clinical insights from global datasets
Devise creative solutions for technical and business challenges to help the team scale
Contribute to shaping the direction of team roadmaps and technology development
Help build our European engineering teams and company culture as we grow
Rapidly iterate on products while maintaining engineering practices that ensure quality and security
Bring or develop a deep knowledge of healthcare in Germany, including data sources, security, privacy, information governance requirements, and emerging trends

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are. You're excited by the prospect of working on difficult and meaningful problems each day. You seek and give candid feedback, and value the chance to make an important impact on cancer patients and society.

You’re a data engineer with 4-8 years of relevant professional experience
You are excited to work in a startup environment, think creatively and be scrappy to get the job done
You are excited about working in a passionate, fast-paced, technology-driven culture
You have a nose for value and empathy for your customers
You have experience with agile development environments using object-oriented programming languages (e.g. Python, C#, SQL), but are also language agnostic and willing to pick up new programming languages as needed
You have experience working with cloud platforms like AWS and data warehouse solutions like Snowflake
You have experience with data processing and orchestration tools such as Databricks, Spark, Ray, DBT, Prefect, and/or Airflow
You act as an expert in your domain area, and as a partner with product teams
You understand the purpose of “boring” technology (as described in this blog post) and are willing to use the right tools to get the job done
You can collaborate and easily explain technical terms to a non-technical, highly sophisticated audience; you have superior communication skills
You are comfortable with ambiguity and always willing to teach and learn
You are fluent in English

Optional

You have experience working in healthcare in Germany or exposure to healthcare-related standards like HL7
You hold a Bachelors, Masters, and/or Ph.D. in computer science or a related field
You have experience in infrastructure, devops, or security engineering
You are conversational in German

Who We Are

Our people are at the centre of everything we do. We strive to foster a culture where our teammates feel equipped and empowered to make meaningful contributions with confidence, compassion, and clarity.

jobs.title: Azure Databricks Developer
jobs.description:
Who are we

DXC Luxoft is a global IT services and consulting company, part of DXC Technology, delivering cutting-edge digital and software solutions worldwide. We partner with leading financial institutions and global enterprises, helping them transform and scale through modern technology.

Join a global community of engineers and be part of building impactful, modern technology solutions!

Development of AI-enabled solutions that support a signal-driven commercial intelligence platform connecting market insights, content creation, sales engagement, and client feedback.

Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Azure Databricks Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure Databricks and Azure DevOps to design and implement scalable cloud-based data solutions. You will work closely with other data engineers, architects, and business teams to develop and optimize data pipelines, real-time data streaming, and cloud-based analytics solutions.

The applications primarily consist of data pipelines built in Azure Databricks. They either transform data and load it into downstream systems, or ingest data from upstream systems and transform it for further processing.

You will be part of the SaaS Data Layer implementation team responsible for building and maintaining the client environments of the new trading platform.

Luxoft will invest into your professional training and allow you to grow your professional career.

Responsibilities:

Cloud expertise in Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps, Azure Log Analytics. Knowledge of Azure network concepts, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions is a plus.
Develop, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks.
Design and manage Azure Databricks for optimized data storage and retrieval.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement data integration solutions across multiple sources and platforms.
Implement best practices for data governance, security, and compliance in cloud-based solutions.
Monitor and troubleshoot performance issues in Azure-based applications and data pipelines.
Automate deployment and monitoring processes using CI/CD pipelines.
Stay updated with emerging Azure technologies and provide recommendations for improvements.
Producing Architectural design diagram/Technical Documentation

Mandatory Skills Description:

10+ years experience in development
3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including Databricks and DevOps.
Strong proficiency Python and Pyspark or SQL for data transformation and analysis.
Experience with real-time data streaming and event-driven architectures.
Deep understanding of ETL/ELT workflows and big data processing frameworks.
Knowledge of Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
Familiarity with data security, governance, and compliance best practices in cloud environments.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile development environment.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Azure network concepts, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions
Agile
Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect.
Experience with Power BI or other visualization tools.
Knowledge of machine learning and AI-based analytics on Azure.

Languages:

English: C1 Advanced
